title: Network Support Engineer L2
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Provide Level 2 support for network issues, troubleshooting and resolving complex technical problems related to routers, switches, and other network devices.
 Configure and manage router configurations on Cisco ASA firewalls, switch configuration on Cisco Switches (3750/6509), and network configuration on Fortinet Firewall.
 Troubleshoot routing protocols such as OSPF, EIGRP, BGP; understand how these protocols work and their applications in real-world scenarios.
 Collaborate with team members to resolve high-priority incidents within SLA timelines.
 Document all resolutions to knowledge base for future reference.
 Desired Candidate Profile 
 4-6 years of experience in Network Support Engineering with expertise in Network Administration, Switch Configuration, Router Configuration, Network Configuration.
 Bachelor's degree in Any Specialization (B.Tech / B.E.).
 Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP protocol suite; familiarity with firewall rulesets like Cisco ASA & Fortigate.

Key Skills: Network Support,Network Configuration,Router Configuration,Switch Configuration,Network Administration,Network engineering,Configuration,Administration
